questions.question: If an 11-digit number 5y5884805x6 is divisible by 72, then the value of √(xy) is? where the value of x should be maximum∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

11 digit number 5y5884805x6 is divisible by 72

**Concept Used:**

If the number is divisible by 72, so we can say the number also divisible by both 8 and 9

Divisibility law of 8 ⇒ A number divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8

Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits are divisible by 9

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5y5884805x6 is divisible by 8 if x = 7

⇒ 5y588480576 is divisible by 9 if y = 7

⇒ √(xy) = √(7 × 7) = 7

questions.question:
In ΔPQR, QT ⊥ PR and S is a point on QR such that ∠PSQ = p°. If ∠TQR = 46° and ∠SPR = 32°, then the value of p is∶

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7251049f3a7129f1996989d333581e7aa22d8a99be1473978ad872de7239488e.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7251049f3a7129f1996989d333581e7aa22d8a99be1473978ad872de7239488e.png] 

Suppose QT and PS intersecting at point O.

∠SPR = 32° and ∠QTP = 90°

In ΔPOT,

⇒ ∠P + ∠O + ∠T = 180

⇒ ∠O = 180° – 32° – 90° = 58°

The income of A is 40% more than that of B. If A got a 25% rise in his income and B got a 40% rise in his income, then the percentage increase in the combined incomes of A and B is∶
questions.solution:
Let the income of B be 100x.

∴ Income of A = 100x × [140/100] = 140x

New income of A = 140x × [125/100] = 175x

New income of B = 100x × [140/100] = 140x

Total income (A + B) after increment = 175x + 140x = 315x

Total income of A and B before increment = 100x + 140x = 240x

⇒ Required percentage = [(315x – 240x)/240x] × 100 = 31.25%

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C, to do a certain work is 7 ∶ 3 ∶ 5. Working together, they can complete the work in 21 days. A and C worked together for 15 days. The remaining work will be completed by B alone in∶
questions.solution:
Ratio of efficiency of A, B and C = 7 ∶ 3 ∶ 5

Total work = (7 + 3 + 5) × 21 = 15 × 21 = 315 days

Work done by A and C in 15 days = (7 + 5) × 15 = 12 × 15 = 180

Remaining work = 315 – 180 = 135

Remaining work B will complete in 135/3 = 45 days

questions.question: A bought an article for Rs. 5,400 and sold it at a loss of 30%. With this amount, he bought another article and sold it at a gain of 60%. What was his overall percentage gain or percentage loss?
questions.solution:
Let the article was bought at Rs. 100x

Article sold at 30% loss, then SP of the article = 100x × [70/100] = 70x

With 70x, he bought another article and sold is at a 60% profit, then

SP of another article = 70x × [160/100]

∴ Required profit percentage = [(112x – 100x)/100x] × 100 = 12%
